verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an API-first inference cloud with no UI dependency. The docs show token-authenticated, OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints driven by an `api_key` and `base_url` from existing SDK code, so it runs headlessly in any script or CI job. It also has automation-friendly controls: `fail_fast` returns an immediate 429, and the flex tier is pitched at asynchronous workloads and evaluations. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
